description: This is a shell script for testing various aspects of the 'git pack-objects' command, including object filtering, integrity verification, error handling, and different filtering modes such as blob:none, blob:limit, and sparse filters. The script sets up repositories, performs pack operations with different filters, and verifies the correctness of the resulting packfiles.

methods.name: parse_verify_pack_blob_oid
methods.description: Parses and extracts object IDs from 'verify-pack' output.
